content: {"summary":"Users report significant delays and failures when deleting photos from iCloud, causing frustration and data loss.[#tk_669246] Photos fail to download even after full battery or Wi‑Fi, especially with optimized storage.[#tk_2118480] Support interactions are often prolonged, with users waiting weeks for account recovery or unable to access help due to two‑factor authentication requirements.[#tk_2862163] Additionally, camera app issues and storage errors prevent photo uploads, leading to incomplete uploads and unexpected daily charges.[#tk_593573]"}
